newsitem.title: UK: BTR 1996 profit down, sees progress in '97.
newsitem.headline: BTR 1996 profit down, sees progress in '97.

text.p: Diversified conglomerate BTR Plc, in the midst of an ambitious shake-up, on Thursday reported 1996 pre-tax profit fell to 1.301 billion pounds from 1.503 billion, beating analysts' forecasts.
With its restructuring on track, BTR said expected its underlying performance to improve steadily in 1997, although currency movements will have some adverse impact on averall progress.
"We are on track with the disposal programme we announced last September and the actions to restructure our operations are proceeding to plan," chief executive Ian Strachan said in a statement.
In a drive to improve cash flow, BTR is focusing on its top industrial manufacturing and engineering operations, while wielding out underperforming activities.
The conglomerate already sold off businesses representing 1.75 billion pounds of 1995 sales against a 2.3 billion pound target by the end of 1997.
Result improvements in most of BTR's continuing businesses were offset by specific factors such as an 11 percent fall in 1996 profits in the Automotive sector, BTR said. ($1=.6202 Pound)
